summary: Tested the Verlauf preview (/verlauf-preview) end to end, backend and frontend. Backend: 9 of 9 pytest checks pass. /api/history?range=3h returns about 180 min (716 points); the 1h, 6h, 12h and 24h ranges still work; /api/live summary and /api/today return the fields the page needs. Frontend: the preview link on /verlauf opens /verlauf-preview and vp-back returns to /verlauf. On /verlauf the charts (11 recharts surfaces), the Grafana link and the SunTimeline still render. The title text is exact, the 'Live Synchron' badge shows, and the view and range buttons report aria-pressed correctly (24h is the default). View and range survive a reload (localStorage vp-view=four, vp-range=6h). In Multilinie, the header changes with the range (1H/3H/6H/12H/24H ZEITFENSTER) and the sample rate follows it (1/3/5/10/15 min, 'Zeitbasis UTC+0'). The legend tiles match the /api/live summary within live drift. Clicking a tile hides its curve (4 to 3 paths, aria-pressed false, opacity-35) and clicking again brings it back. The Akku curve is dashed, the zero reference line is there and the hover tooltip shows the time plus all four values. A real data gap (05:15 to 14:00) breaks the curve instead of bridging it. In 4 Kanäle, PV and Haus are area charts, Akku and Netz are lines with a zero line, and the Akku header reads '-257 W (41%)'. Day balance: the values use German decimal commas. House consumption (3,93) and the autarky badge (46,2%) match the formula recomputed from /api/live and /api/today. Both distribution bars add up to exactly 100%. No horizontal overflow at 390 px or 1920 px in either view. On mobile the channel cards and balance cards stack and the legend tiles wrap. The SunTimeline renders at the end of the page.

minor.issue: Not a bug at the current snapshot interval (about 15 s, about 5,760 points/day). The query sorts oldest first and stops at 10,000 rows, so if snapshots ever come every 8 s or faster, a 24h request would drop the newest data rather than the oldest.

issues: The Activity icon wraps onto its own line above the title. The h1 does not fit next to it, and the wrapping row lets it fall to the next line. Suggest keeping the icon and h1 on one line (e.g. wrap them together with flex-nowrap) and letting only the badge wrap.

In demo mode, charge + export (0,92 kWh) is larger than PV (0,20 kWh). The bar then shows Akku 74% / Netz 26% next to 'Eigenverbrauch: 0,0%' and a title saying '(0,20 kWh = 100%)'. This looks contradictory but is expected because demo values come from different sources. Optional: base the shares on max(PV, sum of segments) or show a hint.

action_items: Optional: keep the title icon and h1 on one line on mobile (TitleBar.jsx line 15).
Optional: make /api/history fetch the newest rows first (sort ts descending with the limit, then reverse), so a high snapshot rate cannot cut off the newest data.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py history(): ascending sort plus limit(10000) keeps the oldest rows if there are too many. Fine at the current rate but fragile.
VerlaufPreview: the live/today poll (every 5 s) has no unmount guard (alive flag), unlike the history effect. Minor: it can set state after unmount.
DayBalance: the PV yield shown in demo mode jumps between polls (0,17 to 0,25 kWh within seconds) because the simulated device counters move. Demo-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verlauf preview Phase 1 is fully verified. The regression test is /app/backend/tests/test_verlauf_preview.py. The headless browser runs in UTC, so 'UTC+0' is expected. The 24h history currently has a real gap from 05:15 to 14:00 UTC (backend was down), which is a good check that gaps break the curve. Direktverbrauch = 0 in demo mode is expected.
